posts.title: EU officials reject Cop31 deal as it 'doesn't speak to reality of the climate crisis' – video
posts.description: The Cop31 climate talks fell into disarray as the EU, UK and allies in the developing world rejected what they called an unacceptable deal on the future of the climate. Ireland's climate minister, Darragh O'Brien, said the EU could not support the proposed deal, in part because it made no mention of fossil fuels. posts.title: Briton swims length of strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental cost of war
